## non-empanelled hospital, in case of emergency  
- (a) CGHS beneficiaries and other Central Government employees including their eligible family members under CS (MA) Rules have the option to go to a nearby Government hospital / empanelled private hospital or even any private hospital, in case of emergency. In case of treatment undertaken at private non-empanelled hospitals under emergency, reimbursement will be limited to CGHS rates or actual, whichever may be lower.
